[IRET.28.6.4.2] `oa_grow` allocates a new zeroed `slots'` (`2·cap` or
`OA_INIT_CAP`) and resized dense arrays, moves the dense arrays by
`memcpy`, and re-seats the slot array only: for each `d ∈ [0,len)`, probe
from `dhash[d] & mask'` to the first empty `slots'` and set
`slots'[i] = d+1`, `dslot[d] = i`. It makes no `hash`/`eq` calls (it uses
cached `dhash`) and **must not** call `val_dtor`.
